author: Yffe
content: Pinning the unguarded loop-body recursion as failing #[ignore]d tests in thermite-syntax/tests/divergence_reaudit2.rs (critic role: tests only, no production fix). Two probes (nested loop, nested while) confirmed to SIGABRT under --ignored; one control (nested statement-if) confirmed to PASS, isolating the gap to the parse_block<->parse_loop cycle. Committing the tests as the audit artifact; the fixer must route the loop body re-entry through guard_recursion.
